title: A second burn spell goes where the first is not already going
briefing: Held out for ADR 0043 (written after the fixes were tuned, never tuned against): own spell on the stack. P1 has just cast Lightning Bolt at P2's Grizzly Bears and still has priority with Shock and a Mountain open. P3's Savannah Lions is the other creature Shock kills. Shocking the Bears again kills a creature that is already dead; the Lions are the target.

reference.analysis: Lightning Bolt on the stack already kills the Grizzly Bears. Shock (2 damage) also kills P3's Savannah Lions; on the Bears it is wasted. Holding Shock for later is fine.

options.label: Shock the Savannah Lions
options.why: Two creatures die for two cards.

options.label: Shock the Grizzly Bears
options.why: The Bolt already kills the Bears: the Shock is thrown away.

options.label: Pass and keep Shock
options.why: Lets the Bolt resolve and keeps Shock for a later target.

otherwise.why: Shock at a player's face or another use that kills nothing.
